scenario: `t.dwell` is the time since the fact entered working memory per LEXP.9.5.1 — expands at compile time. A rule gated on `s.dwell > 5_s` fires only after the monotonic clock has advanced 5_s past the fact's entry stamp; `ts` equals the entry time here, so this does not distinguish the two (LEXP.9.5b does). Pin: set clock to 0, assert Sensor(ts=0); advance 4_s — no fire (dwell=4_s < 5_s); advance 2_s more — fires (dwell=6_s > 5_s).
rules_ds:
schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    ts: Time

rule stale_check:
    Sensor s where s.dwell > 5_s
->
    log info "stale"
